notes.title: Yōso Warriors Development Delay
notes.notes: Hello Everyone! We want to apologize for being quiet lately. We are very excited to announce that we have begun working on a new 3D survival game which we have decided to allocate most of our resources to. As a result, the development of Yōso Warriors will be delayed while we are working on our new project. We are still coming up with new ideas for Yōso Warriors and are also in the process of refining Yōso Warriors’ game mechanics. We will continue to keep you posted as we have more updates to share. Thank you all again for your patience and support.

notes.title: Yōso Warriors Multiplayer Beta Update Now Live
notes.notes: Hello Everyone! Thank you again for your patience. The multiplayer update for Yōso Warriors is now live and ready to play. As always, we would love to hear your feedback so that we may improve the quality of the game. You can provide us with your feedback on our website under Contact Us, or in the discussions section of our Community Hub on our Steam page. A link to our website can be found on our store page. We look forward to continuing our service to you and providing more content for Yōso Warriors.

notes.title: Yōso Warriors Multiplayer Beta Update Coming Soon
notes.notes: Hello Everyone! Thank you very much for your patience. We are almost done with the Multiplayer Beta Update for Yōso Warriors. The update will be live by the end of this week for the public. As you are aware, Yōso Warriors is still in its beta testing phase and we would love to hear any feedback that you may have with regards to the gameplay, layout, bugs, and anything else you would like to share. Please share any feedback you may have on our website under Contact Us, or in the discussions section of our Community Hub on our Steam page. A link to our website can be found on our store page.

notes.title: Yōso Warriors Multiplayer Status Update
notes.notes: Hello Everyone! Our programmer had to undergo surgery last week which will result in a delay in our development while our programmer recovers. We are currently working on the development of the Yōso Warriors multiplayer update. Our goal is to have the multiplayer update ready for a beta release by the end of the calendar year. We will continue to provide updates to our community as we continue to make progress.

notes.title: Yōso Warriors Early Access Released
notes.notes: Hello Everyone! wakiva games is proud to announce the official launch of Yōso Warriors, our very first game, as an Early Access title. For a limited time only, Yōso Warriors will be offered with a 15% discount in honor of the game's launch. We look forward to building our community with you and are excited to see what the future holds.

notes.title: Yōso Warriors Initial Release
notes.notes: Hello Everyone! wakiva games is proud to release Yōso Warriors as our very first game. Yōso Warriors is a brand new trading card game with unique gameplay. You can collect cards, build decks, and battle NPCs. We plan to include multiplayer in a future update to the game. Currently the game is in an open beta phase and we at wakiva games would greatly appreciate your feedback. You can provide us with your feedback either on our game community page or on our website. A link to our website can be found on the Yōso Warriors store page. Yōso Warriors will officially release on April 27, 2021, however a free demo for the game will be available on April 19. We at wakiva games look forward to working with our community in building a great new game!
